about.updateNote: This app does not check for updates automatically. Look for new versions in the release notes.
about.systemDesc: Including these details when you report a problem makes it much easier to track down.
about.privacyDesc: This app does not collect or transmit any of your information.
about.privacy1: Notes, attachments and settings are stored only in the data folder on your PC.
about.privacy2: There is no analytics, no usage tracking, no account, and no server run by the developer.
about.privacy3: AI features run through Ollama on your own machine, so note contents never leave it. Only actions you start yourself reach the internet: web notes, YouTube embeds and Ollama downloads.
about.licenseDesc: This software is distributed under the MIT License. The same text is installed as LICENSE.txt next to the app.
about.ossDesc: This app is distributed with the components below. Select a name to open its project page.
about.ossNote: The full license for the Pretendard typeface is installed at ui/vendor/fonts/OFL.txt. Ollama, used by the AI features, is not bundled with this app and is installed separately.
